messages:
Leo (Support): Escalating RillCo trial — they're hitting embed ingestion quota (429s) and seeing inference timeouts in bot flows. Demo scheduled next Tue, renewal in ~6 weeks. Need CS to lead outreach + enablement. I have logs and a short repro, tagging @Anita for account comms.
Anita (CSM): On it. Can you paste the quota error and a sample request? Is this only the sandbox/trial org or production?
Leo (Support): Only their trial org so far (org id rillco-tnx123). Sample errors below — reproduces with large batch payloads.
Leo (Support): ```
POST /v1/embeddings 
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"quota_exceeded","limit":"ingest_documents_per_minute","usage":120}
```
Leo (Support): And generation timeouts seen in the UI: ```
{"error":"inference_timeout","latency_ms":12050}
```
Maria (CS Ops): I can temporarily raise their trial ingest quota for 48h to keep the demo moving. Do we want a soft statement to the customer explaining the lift + follow-up plan?
Anita (CSM): Yes please raise it. Proposed comms: brief apology, temporary quota lift to unblock demo, invite to a focused enablement session where we run a deterministic test, and share remediation ETA. Can someone draft that?
Leo (Support): I'll draft a short note. We also think this is partially caused by large payloads + aggressive batching from their ingestion job. Repro curl we used: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '@large-batch.json'
```
Anita (CSM): Plan checklist: 1) Maria increases trial quota 2) Schedule 60m enablement call (CS + Support + Eng Runtime) 3) Kiran to run perf profile & propose config changes 4) Record action items in the account playbook and flag renewal risk to Renewals team 5) Capture product feedback and triage to PMs. @oncall-bot can you open a short-lived monitor?
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3175 — Monitor rillco trial uplift (assigned to eng-runtime).
Kiran (Eng Runtime): I'll subscribe to the incident and look at tail-latency graphs. Send the org id + time window. I can run a perf profile and suggest batching/encoding tweaks. ETA ~2hrs.
Anita (CSM): Sent org id and sample payload in DM. Also I'll log this as a 'trial stall' with medium-high renewal risk: customer evaluation blocked but responded positively to quick support.
Maria (CS Ops): Quota lifted for 48h — effective 2026-03-23T15:12Z. Noted in the account timeline.
Leo (Support): Customer notified about the lift and the offer for an enablement session. They were grateful and confirmed Thurs 10am PT for the call.
Anita (CSM): Thanks everyone. After the call I'll update the playbook with the remediation checklist and create a short one-paragraph renewal briefing for Renewals. Please DM any logs or test results. :thumbsup:
Leo (Support): Thanks — will follow up with the draft comm in a sec.
Kiran (Eng Runtime): I'll post initial profiling notes in the incident thread when ready.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for CS escalation. All fields are strings or list of strings as required.
